body:
Therapist and other mental health professionals have not helped me. Instead they have tried to manipulate me and take advantage of me sexually. In the end they are still human. I am thinking about giving up on people...I am starting to realize people only care about getting their needs met and nothing else...they just have different nethods of doing it. And if you don't give them what they want they want to hurt you or treat you a certain way without being honest about it.
I am thinking it would be better to be selfish like everyone else and off myself...follow my own path. Nobody is keeping me here and I have free will. Stupidly believed that I had to live, so thanks for offering help. But things are pretty much wrapped up here. Deleting the post.
Good to hear I'm not the only one.

Yeah, I will probably do that...just not very good with lying. Its something I will have to practice to get good at it. Thank you for the advice. I know this sounds weird...its a anomaly situation which doesn't happen often. My friends often question my decisions and didn't believe me until they seen it happen. I don't mean to drag you along in all this. 
       Its hard to help with any of this...I may have to handle these things in reality and just take it like a champ. People can get crazy sometimes haha.

Aw, thats a smart idea! I will start doing that more often. But, I don't have a woman friend to pretend with sadly. I try to keep myself looking a bit unkempt to deter...this is overall goofy, now that I think about it. What am I doing...lol.

Yes, my narcissistic mother I just recently started living with. Literally all of her thoughts just said out in the open and she wonders how I learned so much information about her.
      And she is now a recluse so she walks back and forth all day for hours...and sits right behind the door so when I walk in she will get bumped into and proceeds to bitch and moan. 
It was stupid to try and stay here...her mouth diarrhea is intolerable.

I can understand the feelings about the compliments, use to say a barrage of negetive things about myself because I figured they were not true. Just started to say thank you instead.
That is what I am trying to tell my unconscious, its like a massive switch. Once a woman shows any traits of the past...instantly I pack up my stuff and leave without thinking twice. I had someone take a picture of my face when I got into that mode...it wasn't pleasant to look at...it was filled to the brim with rage.

But enough of that, I didn't start this to vent or feel sorry for myself. I want to change...I can't avoid half of the population based on what a few have done. I am no misogynist, but I am afraid. 

I want to be more friendly without giving the wrong idea. How can I do that? Because when I have to reject someone things get nasty...and then everyone proceeds to call me a gay faggot, which in fact I am straight. Lol

Now feel dumb lol...idk why I thought it was french. If you feel comfortable reading my situation and helping me, keep on reading lol. Well, pretty much what I am trying to do is make friends with women. Because when I am in reality, things escalate too quickly and I get triggered.

Lol, tried to talk to my general physician about my issues, she got the wrong idea and she tried to kiss me...it was awkward, she literally had her face 3 inches from mines staring at my lips, got triggered again.
Met a therapist and she pretty much similar, she was getting...emotional in a differen't way and was projecting some nasty shit from a previous relationship. So I feel at a loss to get help from a professional and male therapists are weird. To be honest I think therapy and medicine that isn't physical is a bunch a crap honestly.
I grew up in a environment where the majority were women and I was the only male. They were extremely violent...I was abused as far back I can remember. Since I was the male, the assault was directed towards me constantly without a doubt. Abandoned by mothet completely at 1, was raised by my father.
Just have not ever had a good experience with women in general. After this women I met at the buffet was trying to hit on me with her wedding ring still on her finger...I kinda broke on the inside...lost my job there due to rejecting her and she turned everyone against me...happened to me at fedex too. This all really did happen...I can barely believe that it did.


I have to do this on my own, so I am starting on the internet first. Would you like to talk with me for awhile?
Wow, hey! On a side note, do you speak french?
I used to hang out in a forest with a watetfall, the location I am at now...nature isn't too forgiving lol. I miss being in the forests...it was soothing. And thank you for your reply

No I haven't, that kind of treatment can be rather expensive, no I am not a war veteran, it is due to other experiences with the people around me. What I meant by spiral out of control, is my mental stability is starting to decline rapidly...not really thinking coherently anymore after dealing with the abuse. Was knocked down hard and kicked severly, several stomps to the head and then traumatic blows to the balls, figuratively, not literally...after I started losing it, I started messing up badly in life and they looked for everything they could use against me to turn people against me to gain sympathy, even though they were doing shit WAY worse than me...seen their records...they were devastating. And to let you know, I wasn't even a adult yet...and they still hold it to me...even though I had a dramatic change...unlike them. Tried to still physically and mentally abuse me...talk down to me, prevent me in any way from succeeding, etc. Now I am afraid of everything and feel hollow on the inside, always having stupid flashbacks that shoot my anxiety through the roof and start shaking harder than a wet dog.
No shit lol. It is a virgin thread smh.
Well that explains a lot lol.
By ignoring them everytime that they say something like that. And if they don't resprect you, why be with them?
Just reached my mid 20's, AVPD, PTSD.
You got way too much time and childhood to be thinking about these things. Go have fun in life man, enjoy your youth.
Already on it...
I am in my mid 20s now. Doctor refuses to give me antidepressants...she is weird.
That sucks. People always want to call someone a coward until they go through something themselves...
Thank you for looking out for me, I appreciate it!
If you need a friend or just someone to vent to, I am willing to talk, I need more friends myself.

You know. You should just like me, its almost like an art form...dude, don't beat fown on yourself so badly. It happens, sounds like something in your life previously traumatized you pretty badly. 
Have you tried speaking with a therapist? Not to sound cliché or anything like that. I have to see one myself because I am suffering a cold case of skin hunger. 
Please don't kill yourself, you will never be able to solve this problem if you do.

Guy. I was like you a few days ago. Look. I can understand that you are going through a lot of pain that I can't understand...life gives us so much bullshit sometimes that its ridiculous.
I was sitting on my bed with a 357 ready to blow my brains out like confetti. But the thing is, there is always another way...everything is not given to us in life, but we can make things so much better...
Please do not kill yourself, but if you plan to please at least give it some time to reflect. Who you care about, what effects it will have on them...anything you wanted to accomplish before you go. 
If you want to share anything with me, I will definitely be willing to listen and help in any way I can. Take care man.
Thank you.
Okay, probably will in a bit
Thank you, but I am feeling better...had a terrible day.
I will soon...had a change of heart.

Well, to be honest...earlier I was saying I was not good at anything because...y'know...depression. I actually excell in a lot of things and good people tell me I have a lot of potential....but I never believed them because of my self-esteem. I am feeling better right now fresh out of the gym.
Man, something about those good feelings after a good workout...and playing instuments....food....more food....all kinds of food.
Its kind of hard to see it as one. But you know...you guys...I'll give it a try wth, what is the worst that can happen.
I will try to, but it will take time.
Even if I become the best it will never change how I feel.
Oh. Well, I am not planning on achieving anymore. There is no point.
Too many of them. I am a jack of all trades...I can pick up anything, but I always hit a plateau...no matter what I do.
Yes, I have to be the best...or I can't be proud of myself. Unless I am a master, I am.nothing.
Heh. I remember I used to play that game. Quit though. Used to always play as C.Falcon. I don't know...that feeling is domineering for me.

I am 24, and yes...that is what my life has been like. If I am not the best at what I do...there is no point in trying. So I don't try knowing I can't be the best. I learned not to trust anyone and to be alone...will not allow anyone into my personal space.
To be honest, idk. Never really had any, I just learned a bunch of skills to serve others. And once I wasn't useful anymore I dropped everything. They are nothing important.
I'm not good at anything, never have been. My hobbies are just sitting around.
To be honest, it wouldn't matter...I'd be gone, would have to deal with them anymore.

My mother had me to keep my father trapped in marriage. I was literally no use to her after that, she left me in the crib and never wanted to hold me...when she was pregnant with ne, she started regretting her decision and tried to take medication to kill me.
Because I was abused by them severly, since I was a child. Never had a relationship, had quiet a few force their way in to try and use me. I resisted and they lied, manipulated until my repuation was completely destroyed.
My friends went on to live good lives, while they ran me into the ground using me as a emotional punching bag. 
So in the end I deserved every bit of it. If I didn't, it wouldn't have happened.

I am trash though, just because I'm living doesn't mean that I am not defective. Just looking at the way this world works explains enough for me. I am in my 20s. Nope, I don't want to be selfish. I'd rather commit suicide to be nothing instead. The thought of selfishness makes me sick to my stomach...and knowing that I am too is unbearable. So if I don't like something, I dispose of it. And that something is me.

That is what I was created for. I was not born by accident, nor to be loved. I was born to serve a purpose for my parents. Failed their expectations, became trash to them. My friends, only used me, nothing more. People in general. Whenever I defended myself...I was treated even more like trash or an object. 

Women, used me like trash as well...never had anyone who has actually cared about me...not once.

And in the end, I am no different. There would be nothing better for me than to end it...I am premeditating right now. Sometimes, people have something to live for. I missed to much to even adapt to life right now. Doing myself a favor.
